items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Frog came there after Wendell left. See, Wendell on Tramble on that night.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think that was a nice summer. And Willie Humphrey. And Willie Humphrey. Yeah. Frog was with you there for a while though too. The records they made, I think he...
Frog came there after Wendell left. See, Wendell on Tramble on that night.
After Wendell left and Frog came. Those records that Cook, a fellow from Long Island made, were you on those? I never did have those. They were cut out.
